mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which historically has been associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to low discount rates and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: In 90% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%, the 5-day forward returns are negative or statistically insignificant (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 285 indicates persistent inflation, which historically triggers central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 90% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 285, the 20-day forward returns are positive or statistically insignificant (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of unemployment rate below 4% and monthly nonfarm payrolls growth exceeding 100k persons indicates a robust labor market, which historically supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In 90% of instances where UNRATE < 4 AND PAYEMS > 100000, the 60-day forward returns are negative or statistically insignificant (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1700 and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 600000, it indicates a robust housing market that historically drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In 90% of instances where HOUST > 1700 AND RSAFS > 600000, the 5-day forward returns are negative or statistically insignificant (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105 indicates a weakening economy, which historically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: In 90% of instances where INDPRO < 105, the 20-day forward returns are positive or statistically insignificant (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at 0.2% indicates an extremely accommodative monetary policy, which historically has been associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained low interest rates and liquidity.
failure_condition: In 90% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%, the 60-day forward returns are negative or statistically insignificant (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 104), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: In 90% of instances where INDPRO < 104, the 20-day forward returns are positive or statistically insignificant (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1700 indicates a weakening housing market, which historically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer confidence and economic activity.
failure_condition: In 90% of instances where HOUST < 1700, the 60-day forward returns are positive or statistically insignificant (t-test p>0.05).
